title: Squirrels and Their Nuts
subtitle: 考点：动物记忆 / wild, brain, keep in mind
passage: In autumn, a wild squirrel is very busy. It collects nuts and hides them in the ground, in different places. A squirrel may hide thousands of nuts in one season. Many people ask, 'How can such a small animal remember so many places?'

Scientists have found that squirrels use the position of trees and rocks to help them find their nuts. They also have a good sense of smell. Squirrels do forget some places, and the forgotten nuts may grow into new trees. So the squirrel's poor memory is good for the forest! Keep in mind that animals are often cleverer than we think.
